# Terraform Provider B2

> Terraform provider for Backblaze B2.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/README.md): Read requirements, installation, building, testing, and debugging instructions.
- [Terraform Registry](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/Backblaze/b2): Find the provider on the Terraform Registry.

## Resources

- [b2_application_key](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/docs/resources/application_key.md): Review the application key resource schema.
- [b2_bucket](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/docs/resources/bucket.md): Review the bucket resource schema.
- [b2_bucket_file_version](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/docs/resources/bucket_file_version.md): Review the bucket file version resource schema.
- [b2_bucket_notification_rules](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/docs/resources/bucket_notification_rules.md): Review the bucket notification rules resource schema.

## Data sources

- [b2_account_info](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/docs/data-sources/account_info.md): Review the account info data source schema.

- [b2_bucket](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/docs/data-sources/bucket.md): Review the bucket data source schema.
- [b2_bucket_file](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/docs/data-sources/bucket_file.md): Review the bucket file data source schema.
- [b2_bucket_file_signed_url](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/docs/data-sources/bucket_file_signed_url.md): Review the signed URL data source schema.
- [b2_bucket_files](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/docs/data-sources/bucket_files.md): Review the bucket files data source schema.
- [b2_bucket_notification_rules](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/blob/master/docs/data-sources/bucket_notification_rules.md): Review the bucket notification rules data source schema.

- [Application key](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/tree/master/examples/application_key): See an application key example.
- [Bucket](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/tree/master/examples/bucket): See a bucket example.
- [Bucket file lock](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/tree/master/examples/bucket_file_lock): See a bucket file lock example.
- [Bucket notification rules](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/tree/master/examples/bucket_notification_rules): See a bucket notification rules example.
- [File version SSE-C](https://github.com/Backblaze/terraform-provider-b2/tree/master/examples/file_version_sse_c): See a file version with SSE-C example.
